definitions.explanation: Japan's primary law governing civil aviation, including regulations on aircraft operation, airspace use, pilot licensing, and more recently, drone (unmanned aerial vehicle) operation. The law was expanded in 2022 to include comprehensive drone regulations.

examples.japanese: ⟦ドローン→ドローン：06097_doroon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飛|と}ばす→飛ばす：02373_tobasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{航空法|こうくうほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To fly a drone, you must comply with the Civil Aeronautics Act.

examples.japanese: {航空法|こうくうほう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ドローン→ドローン：06097_doroon⟧⟦{飛行|ひこう}→飛行：03578_hikou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Under the Civil Aeronautics Act, drone flights near airports are prohibited.

examples.japanese: {2022年|にせんにじゅうにねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{航空法|こうくうほう}⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦ドローン→ドローン：06097_doroon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{機体登録|きたいとうろく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務化|ぎむか}→義務化：28603_gimuka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: With the 2022 amendment to the Civil Aeronautics Act, drone registration became mandatory.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{航空|こうくう}→航空：02798_koukuu⟧ (aviation; aerial navigation) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (law; act). Enacted in 1952 and regularly amended. Relevant to pilots, airline operators, and increasingly to drone users.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {航空法|こうくうほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧: based on the Civil Aeronautics Act
- {航空法|こうくうほう}⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧: violation of the Civil Aeronautics Act
- {航空法|こうくうほう}⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧: amendment to the Civil Aeronautics Act
